decisions.decision: Scope adds (flashing school zone lights, replacement of turf surface at the existing field, demolition of Thomas C. Passios Building) removed from the list as outside project scope, per Bond Counsel decision letter.
decisions.quote: shared a decision letter from bond counsel stating that the following scope adds are considered to be outside of project scope, therefore to be removed from the list

decisions.decision: A sub committee was formed to review and propose a future location for the athletic achievement history items; the athletic monitor concerns deferred to a later date.
decisions.quote: a sub committee was formed to review and make proposals for future location for the athletic achievement history items.

decisions.decision: Athletic archive touch screen monitor cost concerns to be reviewed later after less costly options are investigated.
decisions.quote: these will be reviewed at a later date, when other, potentially less costly options are investigated by both

decisions.decision: Construction and Design Team directed to look for records of value engineered scope and to see what VE documentation is available.
decisions.quote: the construction and design team will go back in look for records of value engineered scope.

decisions.decision: Artificial turf versus sod left undecided; item to be further reviewed at upcoming meetings, with the design and construction team to research short and long term operational cost analysis.
decisions.quote: the design and construction team will help the school to research and present further information about this subject.

decisions.decision: Chairman's project status update to be added as a standing item on the monthly meeting agenda.
decisions.quote: note: this section will be added to the monthly meeting agenda for future notification and status updates from the chairman of the lsb committee.

decisions.decision: Details on how added air cooling will be managed, who operates it, and its energy cost to be looked at by the Committee and presented once information is available.
decisions.quote: these details will be looked at by the committee and presented once information is available.

budget_items.topic: Change Order No. 7 package, items CR068A and CR068C
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Change order items in the package were priced as additions, including one for miscellaneous FF&E base contract revisions and one for the art storage room.
budget_items.quote: (add $2,455.00) 2. cr068a (rfp-016-rev.1) base contract revisions from ff&e meetings - misc.

budget_items.topic: Change Order No. 7 package, item CR070 added dishwashers
budget_items.what_was_recorded: CR070 added dishwashers in rooms A106 and D144 at an added cost.
budget_items.quote: 4. cr070 (rfp-018) added dishwashers in a106 & d144, (add $2,744.00)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Cooling design cost was given as a range; the committee approved the design work.
budget_items.quote: of $5,000-$10,000. motion: the lunenburg school building committee voted for approve design work for added cooling

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Project reported on time and on budget, with no intention of spending the full contingency fund.
budget_items.quote: despite contingency usage proposals for certain items, there was no intention of expending the project's contingency fund in its entirety.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Monthly progress invoices for work through December 2015 were presented and approved; no amounts printed.
budget_items.quote: presented monthly progress invoices for work completed through december, 2015 for joslin lesser - nv5 (opm)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The space was an allowance in the GMP; final design cost came in higher, offset by a proposed donation of construction by the site contractor, which would make it a net credit.
budget_items.quote: final design came in at a higher cost. however the site contractor, powell, is looking to donate all construction except for electrical scope.

budget_items.topic: Relocation of murals and digital reproduction
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Digital reproduction of murals proposed to avoid costly abatement; Shawmut pricing the item.
budget_items.quote: this mural also does not require costly abatement process due to original adhesion method.

budget_items.topic: Estimate for item in building to be demolished in Phase 2
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Cost presented is an estimate; Shawmut pricing the item.
budget_items.quote: cost presented for this item is an estimate. shawmut is in process of pricing this item.

budget_items.topic: Touch screen monitor for athletic archives
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Concerns raised about the high cost of the software and monitor for this design.
budget_items.quote: concerns were voiced about high cost for the software and monitor for this design.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Cost of a color sign was a concern; a simpler monochrome sign suggested.
budget_items.quote: the cost for the sign was a concern, it was noted that color sign is probably not what the town is looking for.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Turf must be replaced every fifteen to twenty years, a significant lump-sum cost; long and short term operating cost analysis requested.
budget_items.quote: however it has to be replace every fifteen to twenty years which adds a significant lump sum cost.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Question raised whether added air cooling would add cost to the school energy bill.
budget_items.quote: it would be good to understand how the added air cooling will be managed and if it will add cost to the energy bill for the school.

budget_items.topic: Contingency use and Board of Selectmen review
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Citizen noted that available funds do not mean funds must be spent.
budget_items.quote: mr. rodgers noted that just because there are funds available, it does not mean that those funds are to be spent.
